title: Work Centre
intro: The shell (rail, utility bar, open-records strip, account and notifications dialogs) is part of every captured page; its own presets are listed here because the Work Centre is where it is first met.
notCaptured: Partial, Stale and Unavailable freshness. The local fixture cannot force a failed or partial read.
A selected Case item with the Assign Engineer dialog, a populated AI jobs table and a populated New cases list. The fixture holds one Case, already assigned.
A populated notifications list. The fixture user has no notifications.
The command palette. It is opened from the keyboard and lists live search results.

title: Cases
notCaptured: Populated Not ready, Review, Completed, Query and Held queues. The fixture's one Case is With Engineer; the other queues show their real empty state.
The Principal and Missing filters applied, and a second page of results.

title: Create Case
notCaptured: Validation errors after a refused submit, and the refusal mode ("This item cannot become a case").
The address-resolution choice between a found and an entered inspection address.

title: Case record
intro: The record is one Case worked through the application's own edit session by `v28-build/enrich.mjs`: overview notes, repairer and storage, vehicle details, tyres and belts, two recorded damage zones, one Glass's guide entered by hand and applied as the Engineer's Value, two hand-entered estimates, four images of which two are in the report as Close-up and Overview, a repairable outcome and an Engineer's comment. Sections that load as the reader approaches them live are mounted in the saved page the same way `case-workspace.js` mounts them.
notCaptured: Review, Not ready, Held, Query and closed Cases; the fixture Case is With Engineer.
A colleague holding the edit session, Take over, and the refused-save panel ("Your change was not applied").
A generated report or fee note, prepared delivery, and Case documents other than images. Report generation needs sign-off data the fixture lacks.
An imported or Glass's-sourced estimate, and Send to AI.
The save-before-finishing dialog, which the live script raises only when the form is dirty. Edit a field in the edit-session state and press Cancel to see it.

title: Case record states
notCaptured: See the Case record page for the states the fixture cannot reach.

title: Case record sections
intro: Read mode and the edit session are different markup for most sections. Both are captured; compare the pairs.

title: Case record dialogs
intro: These dialogs exist only inside the edit session, so they are presets over that state. Each is opened by the live page's own opener.
notCaptured: Create audit, Release Hold, reopen and the delete-estimate confirmation. The fixture Case does not offer them in its current state.

title: EVA handoff
notCaptured: A Case whose Principal has EVA delivery switched on with a generated report ready to send.

title: Create audit
intro: Create audit is an Actions-menu item on a Case with a recorded outcome that permits an Audit, not a page of its own.
notCaptured: The Create audit dialog. The fixture Case does not meet `CanCreateAudit`, so the live page does not render it.

title: Triage
intro: `/Triage` has no list of its own; it answers with a permanent redirect to `/Cases`, and the list is the Triage tab there.
notCaptured: A Triage with a recorded finding, one awaiting information, one with a linked Case (Unlink case), and the chaser form with attachments.
The edit session on a Triage, and a colleague holding it.

title: Unidentified
intro: `/Unidentified` has no list of its own; it answers with a permanent redirect to `/Cases?tab=unidentified`.
notCaptured: A closed item with Reopen, an e-mail-kind item, and the "Original file unavailable" state.

title: Image intake
intro: Images that arrived before their instruction sit in the Awaiting instruction tab of Cases and open at `/VehicleImages/{id}`. `/PreCaseImages` answers 404 to a GET.
notCaptured: The attach confirmation step ("Confirm and add to this case"), the edit session with tag pickers, and the "Original file unavailable" state.

title: Inbox
notCaptured: A processed message with a classification, a linked Case, attachments with outcomes, a thread, and the move-folder, link and unlink dialogs. The fixture holds one unprocessed message.
Sent Items, Dismissed and Deleted Items with content, and the Submitted and Unknown send states.

title: Upload
notCaptured: Single-file status (`/Upload/Status/{id}`) in its processing, complete and failed outcomes, and upload validation errors. They are responses to a post of real files.

title: Search
notCaptured: More filters applied, a second page, and the invalid-filter validation summary.

title: Operations
notCaptured: AI jobs in Queued, Taken, Draft ready and Failed states with their Complete and Cancel actions. The fixture has no AI work.
